```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(randomForest)
library(ROCR)
library(Boruta)
```

Loading file
```{r}
met_data <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_data.RData")
met_char <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_char.RData")
met_outcomes <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_outcomes.RData")
```
Splitting by cohort and outcome

```{r}
source("../rf_functions.R")
```

Splitting the cohorts into the 
```{r}
train.outcomes <- sorting(met_outcomes,
                          "Met Discovery",
                          "Therapy complete",
                          "Toxicity")

train.outcomes <- arrange(train.outcomes, desc(Sample))


test.outcomes <- sorting(met_outcomes,
                        "Met Validation",
                        "Therapy complete",
                        "Toxicity")

test.outcomes <- arrange(test.outcomes, desc(Sample))


train.seq <- filter(met_data,
                    (Sample %in% train.outcomes$Sample))
train.seq <- arrange(train.seq, desc(Sample))


test.seq <- filter(met_data,
                   (Sample %in% test.outcomes$Sample))
test.seq <- arrange(test.seq, desc(Sample))


```

```{r}
train.outcomes <-
  train.outcomes %>%
  select(Sample,
         `Reason.for.discontinuation`)


test.outcomes <-
  test.outcomes %>%
  select(Sample,
         `Reason.for.discontinuation`)


```


```{r}
seed_list <- c(12345:12369)
```

```{r}
meta_tox_boruta_fullpanel <- kTest(seed_list, "Therapy complete", "Toxicity", "Boruta") 

meta_tox_borutalist_fullpanel  <- grabImp(meta_tox_boruta_fullpanel, seed_list)

saveRDS(meta_tox_borutalist_fullpanel, file = "../Outputs/meta_tox_borutalist_fullpanel.RData")



```


```{r}
table(meta_tox_borutalist_fullpanel$.)
```
